name: THORNode (ninerealms)
summary: The node row that answers THORNODE_NET_0_1 from the public THORNode API at ninerealms. Open source. It is 3, not 4: the API is a public server and its answers (quotes, vault addresses) are not checked, so it is relied on for what a swap pays to. It sees this computer's address. Judged here by its publisher.
